title: Ask me Not
author: Ranjit Dutta
text:
Lost a lot
Spring`s mystical intoxications
Here and now
Dark nocturnal silence ;
Ferocious mind
Bickers in anxiety,
Devils of lust
Pushed me to oblivion
Through tunnels of dark emotions.
Don`t question me
Here and now
I don`t survive as me.
Tumultuous waves
From the breast of the sea,
Calls from hills of hatred
Brazen arms of distress,
Don`t question me
Here and now
I don`t survive as me,
It`s a vicious night
It`s a treacherous night.

Whispers find their way
Laps of security
Puritan stories of my grandma.
Find in hesitance
The lanes of feelings
Strings to the merger
Ganga yamuna
Deep inside my search
Try to fathom
Sermons of Geeta Puran,
Don`t question me
Here and now
I don`t survive as me
It`s a vicious night
It`s a treacherous night.
stanzas: From the breast of the sea,
